description: web_pki_policy(), smime_policy(), and code_signing_policy() all return ValidationPolicy::default() with only current_time_unix set. They do NOT enforce any CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements: no 398-day validity cap, no SHA-1 prohibition, no SAN requirement, no minimum RSA key size. A caller who reads the function name and its doc comment will trust that CA/B Forum constraints are applied; they will not be. This is a silent footgun — no error, no panic, just a policy that looks valid but enforces only RFC 5280 defaults. The functions should either return Err, panic with a clear 'not yet implemented' message, or not be in the public API until implemented.
title: pkix-profiles stubs silently return default policy — wrong CA/B Forum enforcement
